title: Settlement Exception Visibility | BackOfficeFleet
html:
Settlement proof

Keep missing, disputed, and held settlement items accountable.

BOF organizes each settlement exception by type, supporting record, evidence needed, current status, responsible owner, escalation, clearance condition, and downstream effect.

Take the Assessment →

Source record

Settlement line, source work record, POD or receipt, rate or pay input, disputed item, supporting evidence, question, and responsible owner.

Review path

The queue checks the source match, missing or conflicting evidence, dispute state, owner, age, response, and action required for resolution.

Decision-ready output

A ready, watch, or hold exception record with evidence needed, owner, age, escalation path, and next action.

How the work moves

The record keeps the exception, owner, and consequence visible.

An unresolved item remains visible across operations, settlement, payroll, finance, and the affected driver.

  1. 01

    Open the source record

    Settlement line, source work record, POD or receipt, rate or pay input, disputed item, supporting evidence, question, and responsible owner.

  2. 02

    Review the operating question

    The queue checks the source match, missing or conflicting evidence, dispute state, owner, age, response, and action required for resolution.

  3. 03

    Name the exception and owner

    Unresolved evidence is assigned to a responsible person with a clear request, review state, and condition that must be satisfied before the record moves.

  4. 04

    Carry the outcome forward

    A ready, watch, or hold exception record with evidence needed, owner, age, escalation path, and next action. An unresolved item remains visible across operations, settlement, payroll, finance, and the affected driver.

Qualification

Administrative support stays inside a defined boundary.

BOF coordinates administrative exceptions and does not adjudicate disputes, calculate legal entitlement, or authorize payment.

  • Public screens, records, statuses, and integration examples are static or synthetic unless a page explicitly states an authorized live capability.
  • The fleet, carrier, employer, agency, customer, and qualified professionals retain their operating, legal, safety, regulatory, and financial authority.
  • BOF does not guarantee release, acceptance, compliance, payment, collection, savings, audit, safety, or financial outcomes.
  • The BOF assessment qualifies the record set, responsible owner, service boundary, intended output, and appropriate next action.
